note: UART input bytes are copied directly into the CLI receive buffer from attacker-controlled input.
The tracked receive length is advanced by the full incoming chunk, carrying the input size forward.
The code assumes there is always room for a trailing NUL after appending input, but that obligation is violated when the buffer is filled exactly.
When the command is processed, the code reads and then conditionally rewrites the last byte of the receive buffer, which becomes invalid after the overflowed terminator write.
